subject: Human Body
title: Dendritic Cells: The Messengers
description: A quick win: understand Dendritic Cells: The Messengers.

hook.text: Dendritic cells are scouts. They capture invaders, carry fragments to lymph nodes, and sound the alarm.

buildup.text: Found in skin, lungs, and gut, dendritic cells sample their surroundings constantly for foreign material.

discovery.text: They present antigen fragments to T cells. This presentation is what activates the adaptive immune response.

twist.text: Without dendritic cells, T cells would never know an infection is happening. They bridge innate and adaptive immunity.

climax.text: Dendritic cells don't fight directly. They inform, activate, and connect the right defenders to the right threat.

punchline.text: They don't fight. They tell the fighters where to aim.

quiz.question: What is the primary role of dendritic cells?
options: Presenting antigens to T cells to activate adaptive immunity
